notes.title: An Agonized Mind Update 1.3 - New Game Mode and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
An Agonized Mind Update 1.3 is here, bringing a new game mode and several fixes/changes.

Overpowered Mode
Start the game over again with all your upgrades FULLY MAXED out. Also, you have increased speed and stamina refills quicker after sprinting. Those experiments don't stand a chance against #040798 in this game mode created just for some simple fun. You cannot use upgrade stations when in this mode because you are already maxed out. 

Fixes/Changes

Bug Fixes
 Fixed issue where health bar would not adjust according to the player's max health
 If player needs only 1 heal press to heal and use a health kit, this will work now

Changes
 Modified the New Game menu to accommodate the new game mode
 Changed stamina refill delay from 3 seconds to 2 seconds
 Small adjustments to the beginning levels

notes.title: An Agonized Mind - Update 1.2
notes.content:
This is a small update that mainly focuses on making the beginning levels a bit more forgiving since you do not have a weapon yet.

Also fixed a glitch with health not resetting when you died, went to the Main Menu, then continued playing. This fix may help with another glitch where the player is sometimes invincible when reloading a checkpoint -> this might still be an issue though.

notes.title: An Agonized Mind Demo v2.1 Released - Lots of Polish!
notes.content:
Lots of little improvements have been made in this new demo version. Some should make the game more fun and others are really adding more polish to the game.

Notable Changes

Shooting should be way more satisfying now!
Enemies are faster
There are enemy death animations 
Shooting now has recoil
Movement and rotation is smoother
Movement and rotation should feel weightier and much more improved versus an "instant snap"
Sounds have been slightly altered
Some simple bug fixes


If anyone reads this... please leave any feedback you can and please report any issues you come across
